genes.description: One cell's expressed genes as human Ensembl gene IDs (e.g. ENSG00000141510), highest rank first: Geneformer ranks genes by expression normalised by the cell's total counts and by the gene's median across its training corpus. Genes missing from the model's dictionary are skipped; at most 4,094 are used. Give genes or gene_tokens.

gene_tokens.description: The same cell as token ids from Geneformer's 104M token dictionary (the maker's TranscriptomeTokenizer output without <cls> and <eos>), highest rank first.

last_layer.description: Take the embeddings from the last layer instead of the second-to-last (the maker's default, a more general representation).
